explication: Atlantis is a self-hosted Terraform pull-request automation server. A webhook or API request is authenticated and routed into command orchestration, which discovers projects, applies configuration and locks, then runs Terraform operations and returns status/output through the VCS provider. The repository also contains policy checks, drift detection/remediation, plan persistence, job streaming, and lock-management UI. The graph emphasizes sampled runtime wiring; several provider-specific and scheduled paths are represented only at their stable subsystem boundaries.
